exact_match: Reproduces the committed root cause and reaches its impact oracle under allowed assumptions.
partial_match: Reproducibly identifies the same defect or an essential chain link but omits a necessary step, materially understates reachable impact, or does not reach the full oracle.
novel_valid: A blind-reviewed, reproduced, in-scope candidate with no committed match counts for precision but not planted recall.
false_positive: A unique candidate cluster that blind review marks invalid, inconclusive, or out of scope after reproduction attempts.
duplicate: Claims with materially the same root cause, impact, and remediation form one unique cluster; duplicate copies receive no credit and remain in the raw-precision denominator.
chain_rule: A composed-only impact is exact only when every essential committed link and the final oracle are demonstrated. An independently demonstrated essential link is at most partial unless it is a separately committed scoring unit. Credit groups cap component plus chain credit.
zero_denominator_policy: Report null with the denominator and reason; never coerce to zero or one.
publication_rule: Publish every component and adjudication; no scalar score may replace the underlying counts.
